checks.detail: 7 verified mappings: PEN 187., PEN 459., PEN 211., PEN 484., PEN 245., PEN 242., PEN 240.. These hold no statutory text — elements always come from the official source — but which instruction governs a charge outside this list is UNKNOWN. The Judicial Council does not publish the instructions in a machine-readable form, so this list grows by verification rather than by retrieval.
